Huntsman Center]] |champion= |tourney= [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result= First Round }} {{2016–17 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Utah Runnin' Utes men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Utah]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by sixth-year head coach [[Larry Krystkowiak]]. They played their home games at the [[Jon M. Huntsman Center]] in [[Salt Lake City|Salt Lake City, Utah]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 20–12, 11–7 in Pac-12 play to finish in fourth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2017 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to [[2016–17 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]]. They received an invitation to the [[2017 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2016–17 Boise State Broncos men's basketball team|Boise State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utes]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 27–9, 13–5 in the [[2015–16 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in second place. In the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], the Utes defeated [[2015–16 USC Trojans men's basketball team|USC]] and [[2015–16 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]] to advance to the championship game where they lost to [[2015–16 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|NCAA tournament]], as a No. 3 seed in the Midwest Region. They beat [[2015–16 Fresno State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Fresno State]] in the first round before losing in the No. 11-seed [[2015–16 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]] in the second round. ==Off-season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
